GLPERF.title: Performance
GLPERF.hint: Makes Foundry and the suite cheaper to run on every machine at the table, without changing a single Foundry setting. Pick a tier per client (or let Auto choose), set a floor for the table, and measure the difference with the overlay and the 30-second benchmark.
GLPERF.setting.tier.name: Performance tier
GLPERF.setting.tier.hint: Quality changes nothing. Balanced (the default) makes no visible change: a still canvas is redrawn less often, sight is recomputed less often during a move, and effects nobody can see stop costing anything. Performance renders below retina resolution, lightens the glass and snaps sight at the end of a move. Potato drops Foundry to Low and turns every ambient effect off. Auto moves between Balanced and Potato to hold your target frame rate. The GM may set a floor you cannot go above. Affects only this machine.
GLPERF.setting.targetFps.name: Target frame rate
GLPERF.setting.targetFps.hint: What the shared shedding and Auto aim for. Display refresh is capped at 60, so a 144 Hz screen does not strip effects chasing 144. Choose 30 on a machine that cannot hold more.
GLPERF.setting.overlay.name: Show performance overlay
GLPERF.setting.overlay.hint: A small readout of frame time, where the frame goes, what is being shed, and which Foundry values this feature is overriding. Includes a 30-second benchmark that saves a report.
GLPERF.setting.preload.name: Preload navigation scenes
GLPERF.setting.preload.hint: When the GM switches scene, every client preloads the other scenes in the navigation bar. Faster switches, at the cost of bandwidth and video memory on every client, which can make a weak machine slower. Off by default.
GLPERF.patchClientHint: Your own switch for this optimisation. It only runs when both this and the GM's switch are on.
GLPERF.patch.perfMode.name: Canvas quality overrides (table)
GLPERF.patch.perfMode.hint: Lets a tier lower Foundry's performance mode and canvas resolution at runtime, without changing your Foundry settings. Applies at the next scene load.
GLPERF.patch.visionThrottle.name: Sight during token moves (table)
GLPERF.patch.visionThrottle.hint: Recomputes a moving token's sight every few frames (Balanced) or once when it lands (Performance and below), instead of every frame. The largest single cost on scenes with many walls.
GLPERF.patch.appRender.name: Merge repeated window renders (table)
GLPERF.patch.appRender.hint: When one action asks the same sheet to re-render several times, render it once. Every caller still waits for a render that includes its change.
GLPERF.patch.directoryDebounce.name: Batch sidebar refreshes (table)
GLPERF.patch.directoryDebounce.hint: A bulk create, update or delete refreshes each sidebar directory once instead of once per document.
GLPERF.patch.idleFps.name: Idle canvas rate (table)
GLPERF.patch.idleFps.hint: When nothing has moved for a few seconds, the canvas redraws at a lower rate. Any input or movement snaps it straight back.
GLPERF.patch.textureLoad.name: Smoother scene loads (table)
GLPERF.patch.textureLoad.hint: Loads a scene's textures a few at a time instead of all at once, and keeps recent scenes' backgrounds cached, so switching scenes hitches less.
GLPERF.patch.chatPrune.name: Trim the rendered chat log (table)
GLPERF.patch.chatPrune.clientName: Trim the rendered chat log (this machine)
GLPERF.patch.chatPrune.hint: While you are at the bottom of the chat log, only the newest 200 messages stay on the page. Scrolling up loads older ones exactly as before. No message is deleted.
GLPERF.overlay.title: Performance
GLPERF.floor.title: Performance — Table Floor
GLPERF.floor.menuHint: Set the best tier each machine may run, mark capture clients, and pull a performance report from any connected player.
GLPERF.floor.hint: A floor is the best tier a machine may run. A player can always choose something cheaper, never something better. A per-user row replaces the world floor for that user. A capture client never pauses effects when its window is hidden, because an OBS browser source is hidden while it records.
GLPERF.floor.captureHint: This login is recorded or streamed. It never pauses effects when hidden.
